headline: A 2004 executive order directs federal agencies to encourage new ideas and technology in American manufacturing.
what_it_does: This order from President George W. Bush tells federal agencies to support innovation in manufacturing. No official summary was provided, so the specific programs, rules, or funding it covers cannot be confirmed from the title alone. Executive orders like this usually guide how agencies set priorities rather than create new laws.

who_it_affects.how: They may see more federal attention or support for research and new technology in manufacturing.
They are directed to give more weight to manufacturing innovation in their work.
